28: Yesterday Luna found something in the park, and that is how the adventure started. She went under a bench, she took an old leather bag in her mouth and she came back very proud. Mateo saw the bag, Sofía opened it, and inside they got a surprise: a map, a photo and a small silver key. Who lost it? Nobody knows yet. What happened to YOU yesterday? Tell it with went, saw and found!
29: The scariest afternoon of the year: for two hours nobody knew where Luna was. First Sofía looked for her in the garden. Then she called her name at the lake. Then Mateo made a poster with her photo and put it on the bench in the park. They were very worried — until a small girl arrived with Luna on a lead. First, then, finally: that is how you tell a story!
30: Science of sizes! Erik measures everything in the club house with a very long tape. My robot is smaller than Luna, he says, but Luna is faster than my robot. Valentina is taller than Mateo, this box is bigger than that one, and the old lamp is older than everybody in the room. Which is bigger, a whale or a bus? Compare two things near you and say it!
31: Class records day! Who is the fastest runner? Mateo, easily. Who is the best singer? Valentina, and everybody agrees. Who has got the biggest lunchbox? Mateo again. Who is the funniest? Erik, but he doesn't want to be. They write every record on the wall with a golden star. Who is the tallest in YOUR class? Find your records and write them down!
32: Numbers mission: count everything in the club house! Erik counts the books — forty-two. Mateo counts the pencils and gets sixty, then seventy, then starts again because he lost the number. There are ninety steps to the tower and one hundred stars on the ceiling, painted by Valentina. How many chairs are there in your classroom? Count in tens and check!
33: Erik built a clock that barks the hours, and Luna is very confused: at three o'clock she answers three times. What time is it? Half past eight — time for school. What time is the film? At seven o'clock in the evening. Sofía prefers her old watch, which is quiet and always right. What time do you get up? Look at the clock and say it in English!
34: Four seasons, four adventures! In spring the fjord is full of flowers and the rain makes rainbows. In summer they swim in the lake every afternoon. In autumn the wind takes the leaves and the sky is grey with clouds. In winter everything is white and quiet. Erik likes all of them; Valentina likes summer twice as much. Which season do YOU like best?
35: Toy sale for the school garden! Everything on this table has an owner: whose robot is this? It's Erik's. Whose kite is this? It's Mateo's — no, it's Sofía's, look at the name. This ball is mine, that one is yours. They sell almost everything, and at the end Mateo buys back his own robot. Whose things are on your desk? Ask and answer with Whose!
36: Top secret! Sofía's birthday is on Friday, so the Club is going to prepare a surprise. Valentina is going to make the cake, Erik is going to invent something that throws balloons, and Mateo is going to invite everybody — quietly. Next week they are going to remember this party for a long time. What are YOU going to do at the weekend? Make a plan!
37: The school show is ON! The curtain is opening, the lights are changing colour and the audience is clapping. Valentina is dancing in a blue costume, Mateo is acting like a very dramatic king, and behind the stage somebody is looking for the lost hat. Everybody is doing something at the same time. What is happening around you right now? Say it as you see it!
38: Simon Says, club edition! Stand up. Turn around. Open your book. Don't look at your friend's page! Sit down, wait, listen. Sofía gives the orders very fast and Erik does everything one second late, so he is always out. Then Erik gives the orders and nobody understands his inventions. Play with your class: give the order, and be quick!
39: Mateo's lunch is famous: a bowl of soup, two pieces of chicken, a lot of bread, some salad — a little salad, to be honest — and a big glass of milk. Valentina eats some rice and an apple, and looks at his plate with respect. There is a lot of food on this table, she says, but not for long. How much do YOU eat for lunch? Describe your plate!
40: Show and tell: my favourite animal! Sofía chooses the dolphin, because it is clever and it can swim very fast. Mateo chooses the kangaroo: mine can jump three metres, he says, and he tries to jump too. The penguin can't fly but it can swim; the parrot can talk but it can't be quiet. Which animal do YOU like? Say what it can and can't do!
41: Jungle documentary night at the club house! Sofía knows every animal on the screen: the monkeys are noisy, the snake is long and quiet, the crocodile is dangerous and the elephant is enormous but gentle. Erik takes notes for a new invention: a camera that hangs from a tree. What lives in the jungle? Watch, listen and describe every animal!
42: Story time with Valentina: the octopus who wanted to hug everyone! He had eight arms and too much love, so the crab ran away, the starfish said no thank you and the jellyfish just floated past. In the end a friendly shell said yes, and they were friends for ever. Under the sea, between the waves, everything has a story. What lives under the sea?
43: Erik made a treasure game in the club garden! Follow the map: go straight for ten steps, turn left at the tree, cross the little bridge and turn right at the flowers. Mateo turns left when the map says right and ends up in the neighbour's garden — twice. The treasure is a box of biscuits. Give directions to your friend: can they find the treasure?
44: Valentina's friend Emma moved to another city, so now they write real letters. Dear Emma, she writes, we have got news: Luna found a bag with a map inside! She tells her about school, about the club and about the rain. At the end: write soon, love from Valentina. Then she sends it at the post office. Who would YOU write to? Start your letter with Dear!
45: SURPRISE! It worked! Sofía opens the door and finds ten guests, thirty balloons and one enormous cake with candles. Her birthday is on the fourth of May and today she is eleven. There are presents on the table and games in the garden, and Erik's balloon machine works — a little too well. When is YOUR birthday? How old are you? Come and celebrate!
46: Club tradition: pancake Saturday at Café Aurora! Can I have pancakes with honey, please? asks Mateo, who always orders the same. Can I have a hot chocolate and some toast? asks Valentina. Anything else? says the waiter. Yes — more pancakes. Then comes the bill, and everybody looks for coins. What do you order in a café? Practise and ask politely!
47: Grandma's photo album is open on the table. Look — this is Valentina's mother when she was little, with a huge hat. Here is grandpa with his first bicycle. In this photo Erik was a baby and he was already looking at a machine. They laugh, they remember, and they take a new photo for the album. What were YOU like when you were little?
48: Word Games afternoon! Erik and Sofía play everything: spelling races, opposites, guessing with clues, finding pairs. Big — small. Hot — cold. Clue: it is an animal, it can fly, it is not a bird. A bat! Luna sleeps under the table, tired of so many words. Do you remember all the words of the course? Choose a game and play with your class!
49: Exam secrets from the Fjord Club! Valentina's rules: listen twice, because you always hear the answer the second time. Read the example first — it tells you what to do. Colour carefully and only what they ask. Mateo adds his own rule: check everything at the end, because he always writes his name last. Ready for the exam? Take a pencil and breathe!
50: Fifty units — the Fjord Club did it! There is a graduation at the club house: certificates on the table, one for each explorer, and a diploma for Luna too, with a paw print instead of a signature. Erik, Valentina, Sofía and Mateo remember every adventure: the lake, the farm, the lost bag, the surprise party. Thank you, team. And YOU are in the photo too!
